prompt: Implement parse_duration(s) that turns strings like "2h30m", "45s", "1h5s" into total seconds (int). Units: h, m, s; any subset, in h->m->s order; reject empty strings and unknown units by raising ValueError. The current version only handles pure-seconds strings like "45s".

outcome.note: Kept as-is; used in the cron config parser.
